Members

IntroLoader

Command-Line & Spec-Driven Intro Loader

Establishes the Software Engineer identity before transitioning into the UX/UI. Displays a bold centered percentage load counter and rapid spec terminal sequence.

init

Builds the overlay DOM + starts the line sequence.

runAnimation

Steps through the spec lines with the decode-in effect.

finish

Completes the loader: fades the overlay and calls onComplete.

destroy

Releases the context, buffers, listeners and rAF handle so the canvas can be GC'd.
